I couldn't write these notes because I wasn't able to research anything this turn. My only tool for searching and reading web pages was blocked from the start ("no more code_execution tool calls remaining"), so I opened none of the sources. Your rules say to report only what the pages say, with a URL for each point, so I haven't written anything from memory.

Next turn I'd start with these pages:

- **Verse-by-verse traditional reading:** enduringword.com (Guzik on Song of Solomon 6), and biblehub.com's pages on chapter 6 from Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary, plus preceptaustin.org's Song of Solomon list.
- **Where Protestant traditions differ:** sermons and articles on "I am my beloved's" (6:3) at spurgeon.org, desiringgod.org, ligonier.org and thegospelcoalition.org, and Wesley's notes at wesley.nnu.edu.
- **Other views:**
  - netbible.org notes on chapter 6, for Tirzah, "troops with banners," v. 12 and Mahanaim.
  - bibleodyssey.org articles on the Song of Songs.
  - Readings from the early Church writers on newadvent.org, ccel.org and oca.org, such as Gregory of Nyssa's homilies on the Song.
  - gotquestions.org on the Shulammite.

Ask me to go ahead and I'll write the notes from those pages, with a URL for every point.
